title: Smart workplace & automation
summary: Lighting scenes, device control and energy-efficient systems built into the interior.
intro: We plan automation alongside the interior, so lighting scenes, appliances and devices respond from one place or by voice through Alexa, and blend into the design rather than being added later.

points.title: Smart lighting and scenes
points.text: Lighting set up as scenes, so a room changes mood with one command.

points.title: Voice control
points.text: Lights, appliances and devices that respond to voice commands through Alexa.

points.title: Device control
points.text: Appliances and devices controlled from one place.

points.title: Energy efficiency
points.text: Energy-efficient lighting and appliances that bring running costs down.

metaDescription: Office automation in Mumbai: smart lighting scenes, voice and device control and energy-efficient systems, built into the interior.
